name: Concept H: Distributed sundiver chip swarm
description: Exotic conditional flyby swarm, docs/analyses/nano-swarm.md (issue #74). Split the 1 kg probe allocation into 1,000 independent 1 g chips. Each carries ~0.646 m² of the assumed Concept G mirror (~0.323 g), giving ~1.323 g total per vehicle and the same beta and solar v_inf = 300 km/s. Starts on an already delivered 5.204 AU aphelion / 3 R_sun ellipse. The displayed trajectory is one representative chip, not 1,000 propagated vehicles. Splitting preserves areal density and speed; no speed bonus is claimed. The assumed 90% solar reflection, 10% absorption, emissivity 0.8 per face and 0.5 g/m² sail/support imply ~1666 K. Materials, shielding, delivery and millennia-long chip survival are unproven. This is a distributed flyby: braking, gathering, self-assembly and an ISRU factory are not modeled or established.

events.notes: Representative independent chip: 1 g probe allocation includes bus, shielding and controls; ~0.323 g sail/support across ~0.646 m². Constant-beta radial deployment at 3 R_sun; same speed and thermal regime as Concept G. Retained sail to infinity; no capture or assembly event.
